title: Relational analysis of synthetic regional records
question: How do these four synthetic observations differ by region?

queries.name: groups
queries.sql: SELECT p.region, r.service, COUNT(*) AS observations, AVG(p.income) AS mean_income FROM people p JOIN regions r ON p.region = r.region GROUP BY p.region, r.service ORDER BY p.region

queries.name: unmatched
queries.sql: SELECT p.* FROM people p LEFT JOIN regions r ON p.region = r.region WHERE r.region IS NULL
